provenance: REAL DATA, derived. The catalog published on this project's data branch at 2026-11-15T19:52:20Z (19,572 objects, from CelesTrak). Each object classed PAY or R/B by the satellite catalog is shared out between 50 km height bands starting at 150 km, in proportion to the time its orbit spends in each (simulate.ts, addResidence), with the semi-major axis taken from the mean motion. "working" counts those whose status code is +, P, B, S or X.
